objectiveCriteria.claim: The controlled Node Three scene produces sky, object-hit, and ground-hit pixel inputs that the CPU soft-shader can evaluate without leaking endpoint fixture ids into evaluate(...).
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected-pixel diagnostics from record 058: finite display output, normalized rays, finite positive hit distances for card/ground, and no supplied hit distance for the sky control.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: The accepted Node bridge probe proves the selected sky/card/ground pixels produce finite CPU soft-shader display output while keeping endpoint fixture ids out of evaluate(...).

expectedValueSource.policy: Use record 058 for bridge-contract acceptance only; final objective RGBA gate values require later externally sourced fixture materialization.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Record 058 accepts finite output and routing criteria, not final RGBA parity.

scenes.notes: First implemented scene row. Browser/WebGL input is not required for this descriptor.

objectiveCriteria.claim: With zero atmosphere and no light contribution, selected source pixels are not modified by hidden shader, display, or composition behavior.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected black, white, saturated red, and saturated blue pixels decode to the materialized passthrough RGBA values for the configured display/readback policy.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Selected color-bar pixels equal externally materialized passthrough RGBA values under the selected display/readback policy.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values must come from an external fixture or accepted external-source-backed record for the passthrough display/readback policy.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: CPU exact or fixture tolerance; GPU/browser tolerance must be perception/readback grounded.

scenes.notes: Planned descriptor row; final numeric RGBA values are intentionally not invented here.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Externally sourced CIE/display fixture spectra propagate through BrunetonColorDisplayModel into expected rendered pixels with no alternate color conversion path.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected red, green, blue, and neutral spectral fixture pixels match materialized RGBA values derived from the CIE-backed fixture table and validated display model.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Selected spectral fixture pixels equal externally materialized BrunetonColorDisplayModel RGBA values; no alternate color conversion is allowed.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values must be materialized from external CIE/display fixture data and the validated display policy.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Fixture-owned display tolerance for CPU; perception/readback grounded tolerance for GPU/browser.

objectiveCriteria.claim: No-hit sky pixels compose as path radiance only, with no endpoint radiance contribution.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected sky pixels match materialized L_path display RGBA values and diagnostics classify atmosphere exit with no scene endpoint.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: No-hit selected pixels match externally materialized display RGBA for L_path with no endpoint radiance.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values must be produced by an accepted CPU baseline record using public evaluate(...) and externally sourced fixture facts.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: CPU record tolerance from fixture/baseline; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Opaque finite endpoints cap the view ray and compose as endpointRadiance * T_view + L_path at near, mid, and far distances.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Near/mid/far selected pixels match materialized fixture-derived RGBA values and distance trend while the sky control remains endpoint-free.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Same fixture at near/mid/far distances matches externally materialized endpointRadiance * T_view + L_path display RGBA values and distance trend.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values must be generated in an accepted CPU soft-shader record from externally sourced ray-path and endpoint fixture data.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: CPU expected values from accepted fixture record; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Invalid depth is classified and logged without aborting the render or corrupting neighboring valid pixels.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Invalid selected pixel records the configured invalid classification/omission policy and the valid neighbor matches its materialized expected output.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Invalid selected pixel is classified invalid under the configured omission policy while neighboring valid pixels still match externally materialized output.

expectedValueSource.policy: Invalid-depth classification and valid-neighbor RGBA values must come from controlled fixture rows or an accepted external-source-backed record.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Invalid classification exact; valid neighbor uses fixture/CPU record tolerance and GPU perception/readback tolerance.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Same-distance object hits share transport distance while different endpoint fixtures change only postprocess composition.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected same-distance card pixels share hit-distance/T_view diagnostics and differ in final materialized RGBA according to their endpoint fixtures.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Cards at the same distance share hit-distance and T_view diagnostics but produce different externally materialized fixture-derived final pixels.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values require materialized endpoint spectral fixtures and an accepted CPU baseline record.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Geometry diagnostics exact/fixture tolerance; RGBA values from accepted external-source-backed record.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Changing only endpoint distance changes transport while preserving the endpoint fixture identity outside evaluate(...).
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected near/far pixels for the same fixture produce materialized RGBA deltas and diagnostics consistent with different path radiance and transmittance.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Same fixture at different distances produces externally materialized pixel deltas from path radiance and transmittance changes.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values require accepted ray-path fixture values and CPU baseline materialization.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Distance trend and RGBA deltas from accepted fixture/CPU record; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Red, green, blue, neutral, and ground-like endpoint spectra remain distinguishable after transport and display conversion.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected fixture pixels match materialized source-backed RGBA values and satisfy the declared separability checks.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Red/green/blue/neutral/ground-like endpoint spectra match externally materialized display RGBA values and remain separable.

expectedValueSource.policy: Historical shader-lab spectra are seed provenance only; final numeric RGBA values require reconciliation-owned fixture data with external provenance.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Fixture separability and RGBA values from external fixture record; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: The active spectral basis shape is enforced and first/last active channel fixture values survive display conversion.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values and basis rejection rows require external-source-backed fixture materialization.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Basis shape rejection exact; RGBA fixture tolerance from external source-backed record.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Cache-enabled output changes only through the accepted incident-radiance cache contribution.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected cache-off/cache-on pixels match materialized RGBA values and cache delta diagnostics from the cache-owned fixture or accepted cache-backed CPU record.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Cache-on output changes only by externally materialized accepted incident-radiance contribution compared with cache-off control.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values require cache-owned fixture materialization or accepted M1-cache-backed CPU record.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Cache delta from accepted fixture/record; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Unexpected cache boundary or miss conditions log and continue without silently contributing invalid data.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Cache-miss selected pixel follows the configured miss classification while valid control pixels still match materialized expected output.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Cache miss selected pixel follows configured miss policy while valid control pixel still matches externally materialized expected output.

expectedValueSource.policy: Cache miss classification and final RGBA values require cache-owned fixture rows before becoming a gate.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Miss classification exact; valid-control RGBA from fixture/record.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Long shallow horizon rays remain finite and follow the sourced/model-owned expected display trend without clipped artifacts.
objectiveCriteria.measurement: Selected horizon pixels and horizon band diagnostics match materialized trend/RGBA values and report no non-finite or unexpected clip classifications.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: Controlled horizon selected pixels and region match externally materialized expected display trend without non-finite or clipped artifact classifications.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values require accepted CPU baseline record using sourced/model-owned ray-path boundaries.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Expected trend and RGBA values from accepted record; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: High-altitude atmosphere boundary behavior uses sourced U.S. Standard Atmosphere profile rows and consistent top-boundary/exit classification.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.description: High-altitude selected sky pixels match externally materialized display values for sourced profile rows and classify top-boundary/exit consistently.

expectedValueSource.policy: Final numeric RGBA values require externally sourced atmosphere profile fixture rows and accepted CPU baseline materialization.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Profile row tolerance from source-backed fixture; GPU tolerance perception/readback grounded.

objectiveCriteria.claim: Every objective render retains PNG artifacts and comparison metadata whose decoded pixels match the values actually compared.

expectedValueSource.policy: This row validates artifact retention/readback policy; final numeric RGBA values are owned by each rendered objective scene.

expectedDisplayPixelClaims.tolerancePolicy: Encoding/readback tolerance must be declared by the runner record and grounded in browser/readback behavior.
